dataset: PKLot (de Almeida et al., 2015), CC BY 4.0, UFPR; 603-frame seeded subset of the Voxel51/PKLot mirror, 67 frames per view and weather
augmentation: brightness/contrast jitter, flips, quarter turns, noise; low light for half of each batch (to 12 % brightness, gamma, noise, colour casts)
note: validation_accuracy is on held-out frames from the same three views (optimistic); see docs/evaluation.md for leave-one-view-out accuracy
